adapt: Adapt this static Agent to a native Agent
boundary: Preserve the reviewed prompt and tool restrictions, then publish disabled. Source approvals, user-question permissions and unsupported dependencies stay pending.
failed: Compatibility could not be confirmed. Retry the original preview.
updateRequired: Update the target to adapt Agent definitions.
unsupported: This definition needs unsupported behavior or dependencies. Keep its original pending definition for review.
inherit: Inherit the current model when spawned
target: Use a configured provider and model
modelBoundary: Source model aliases do not select native models. The configured deployment is checked at spawn and pinned for continuation. A changed deployment requires a new Agent.
confirm: I reviewed the source prompt, native model mapping and restricted tools. Publish disabled.
